query_selection: round-robin games, hash-ordered games and clips; fixed before retrieval
orientation: shared 180-degree rotation of all five players and ball toward left basket
corpus_definition: All usable clips in accessible nonduplicate public archives passing the declared SportVU integrity and corrected-shot physical filters; not the whole NBA season or sensor-clean ground truth.

illustrative_policy.primary: hash-first test query, regardless of outcome
illustrative_policy.optional_best: smallest exact optimal distance, labelled as selected
illustrative_policy.median: median top1 quality rank including empty answers ranked last
illustrative_policy.difficult: worst top1 quality rank including empty answers
illustrative_policy.results: candidate-reranked top1 and next-ranked candidate from a different database game, with actual rank displayed
illustrative_policy.claims: Geometric trajectory similarity only; ball context only; untimed topK diagnostics, no tactical-semantic or top5 timing claims.

timing_policy: Explicitly authorized sequential single-core benchmark; preparation never times indexes.
recall_claim: Empirical tuning acceptance, not an all-random-seeds 95-percent recall certificate.
